### Interactive board (ISSUE-50 prototype)

The buttons in **Board Controls** write the board's `category` param — the **Category Size** widget's config literally says `"category": "{{...}}"` pointing at that param. One click re-resolves the config and re-fetches the widget against the new collection.

Try it, then inspect with ⚙ on either widget. (Fun fact: this note originally contained the placeholder literally — and markdown cards resolve params too, which is the documented ISSUE-41 collision caveat, demonstrated live.)
